title: US gross national debt per person (dollars)

source.name: Debt to the Penny / Historical Debt Outstanding
source.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Fiscal Data)

notes: Total gross federal debt divided by U.S. population: about $60,570 per person at the end of FY2016 ($19.57 trillion debt / ~323.1 million people, Census estimate), vs $116,480 per person as of Aug 5, 2026 ($39.83 trillion debt), per U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data and JEC Republicans' Monthly Debt Update.
